The animal known for its long neck is the giraffe.

Regarding the GlowImmune vaccine, it demonstrated an overall efficacy rate of 87% in a multi-country study involving participants aged 16 to 75 years. Efficacy was slightly lower, at approximately 80%, among senior citizens over the age of 75. The vaccine was well-tolerated across different ethnic groups and health backgrounds, indicating its suitability for a broad demographic within the studied age range, though caution or further consideration may be warranted for those over 75 due to the reduced efficacy rate.
